Name: Lost Item Recovery
Author: Mysteriam
Description:
[b]How it works:[/b]
After you pass out you can visit the Adventurers Guild to get back every lost item. Keep in mind it only shows the most recent death, so if you die again before recovering your items, they will be lost. (You could always reset the day to before this happened if you run into this issue)

Items are by default priced at half their sale price and recoverable instantly but this can be changed in the config if you would like.


[b]Config:[/b]
CostMultiplier is the percentage of item sale price that you pay to get your items back. Setting it to zero will make all items free.
DaysTillRecoverable is the amount of days you have to wait for your items to appear in the store. Setting it to zero will make items show up instantly.

[b]Commands[/b]
If you would like to edit the config values without exiting the game you can use these commands.

Sets CostMultiplier value
[code]ir set_cm <value>[/code]

Sets DaysTillRecoverable value
[code]ir set_rt <value>[/code]

If you would like to see info on time since last death and time till recoverable.
[code]ir debug[/code]
